title: Mission Control Idle Signal v1
description: Authenticated idle signal forwarded by the Mission Control telemetry sidecar to the Hermes gateway control endpoint when a non-ended session transitions from live to idle. Emitted exactly once per transition; re-armed only after the session is observed live again. Carries no transcript or raw provenance.

transition_key.description: Stable, monotonic key identifying this specific live -> idle transition for the session (e.g. live_to_idle:<session_id>:<n>).

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the transition was observed.
